name: Titan Company Ltd
about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO). [1]
keyPoints: Part of the Tata Group[1] [2] The company benefits from its association with the Tata Group, one of India’s most established and diversified business conglomerates. As of FY26, the Tata Group held a 25% stake in the company, including a 21% shareholding through Tata Sons Pvt Ltd., while Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation Limited (TIDCO) held 28%.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 34.4%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 27.9%
Company's median sales growth is 22.1% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 24.3 times its book value
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
